# A method on a type reads its receiver and the page's state, run on the
# interpreter and in a browser. testdata/type_method_receiver.txtar is the
# compiled half: a golden shows the parameter list, and only running it shows
# that `bonus` was read off the receiver, which has no such field.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Pt {
    x int
    y int
}

var bonus = 1
var n = 1

func Pt.sum(q Pt) int {
    return q.x + q.y + bonus
}

func list<T>.pick() => this[n]

component main ui.node {
    var p = Pt{x=1, y=2}
    var xs = [10, 20, 30]
    var sum = 0
    var picked = 0

    effect(@mount {
        sum = p.sum()
        picked = xs.pick()
    })

    ui.text(value="{sum} {picked}")
}

func testTypeMethodsReadTheirReceiver(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.sum == 4)
    t.assert(c.picked == 20)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/main/1 --

      "Passed": true
